description: Fork of exp567 (E=96, 1.4768 @ 103.02M / 475 Mbits/token). ONLY change: out_proj out_input_nap 6->4 AND out_tph 1024->2048. Ports exp390's recipe (tiny LUT-LM SoTA, -0.021 vs baseline) to the E=96 mid-scale backbone. Trades NAP-depth for table-count: 16 rows x 2048 tables instead of 64 rows x 1024 tables; same total entries (32768 vs 65536 — actually HALF), but ROW COVERAGE at bs=16 jumps 4x (~512 vs ~128 tokens per row per step). Targets the row-collapse pathology that hurts NAP=8/6 at small batch (exp386/387/390 series finding). Resulting model: ~84.1M params (-18.9M out_proj), 493 Mbits/token (+18.8 Mbits out_proj bandwidth, still well under vanilla 742). Adjudication vs exp567 1.4768: win = NAP=4 mechanism transfers to E=96 mid-scale (predicted -0.010 to -0.025); flat = backbone scale absorbs the row-coverage problem; regression = bandwidth shift wasn't worth the NAP-depth loss. Refs: exp390 tiny SoTA 1.6009, exp387 multi-NAP 1.6097, exp569 multi-NAP at E=96 trailing 1.6086@3K (killed). vanilla-untied exp476 1.4143 / 742 Mbits.
